title: Getting to know the General
author: Jake Wildstrom
description: In this game, you play as a man who looks rather like author Neil Gaiman, and you're in yet another mess. You were trying to save money by flying to Atlanta inside a large suitcase, but instead, you've ended up in Alexander the Great's room at the Hilton Buenos Aires and the Macedonian general is rather upset to find you inside what he thinks is his suitcase.
